required.quote: No journeyman or contractor license shall be renewed unless the licensee has completed the required hours of continuing education as determined and approved by the Committee.

available.quote: The Board may, in its discretion, issue a license by reciprocity to an applicant who is currently licensed to practice an applicable trade in another state, country, territory, province or city outside of the State of Oklahoma

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in another jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements, must have lawfully practiced the trade for 1 year immediately prior to application, must have no pending disciplinary matters, and the original license must have been obtained by examination.
requirements.quote: That the requirements for licensure in the city, state, country, territory or province in which the applicant is licensed are deemed by the Board to be substantially the same or equivalent to the requirements for obtaining an original license by examination in force in this state

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing" means, and includes: all piping, fixtures, appurtenances and appliances for, and in connection with, a supply of water within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance, on the premises and to the connection with a water main or other source of supply; all piping, fixtures, appurtenances and appliances for sanitary drainage or storm drainage facilities, including venting systems for such facilities; the installation, repair, maintenance and renovation of all piping, fixtures, appurtenances and appliances for a supply of water, or for the disposal of waste water, liquid waste, or sewage; and the installation, repair and maintenance of radiant-floor heating system piping in residential homes with capacities no greater than one hundred thousand (100,000) BTU's.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means, and includes: all piping, fixtures, appurtenances and appliances for, and in connection with, a supply of water within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance, on the premises and to the connection with a water main or other source of supply

license_tiers.quote: "Apprentice" or "plumber's apprentice" means any person sixteen (16) years of age or older who, as the principal occupation of the person, is engaged in learning and assisting in the installation of plumbing under the direct supervision of a licensed journeyman plumber or plumbing contractor

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A plumber's apprentice must work under the direct supervision of a licensed journeyman plumber or plumbing contractor.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: engaged in learning and assisting in the installation of plumbing under the direct supervision of a licensed journeyman plumber or plumbing contractor

value: qualified training and experience while on active duty with the armed forces of the United States (honorably discharged within 1 year of application)
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: The Board shall adopt procedures and rules to review and accept proof and documentation of an applicant's qualified training and experience as a journeyman plumber or plumbing contractor while on active duty with the armed forces of the United States when such service member has been honorably discharged from active duty within one (1) year of the application

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: The installation, maintenance, repair, renovation of automatic sprinkler systems and related mechanical appurtenances beginning at a point where the pipe or piping system provides water used exclusively for these automatic sprinklers and their related appurtenances and to standpipes connected to automatic sprinkler systems

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: it shall be unlawful and a misdemeanor for any person, firm, partnership, association or corporation to act as a master plumber or plumbing contractor or to engage in or offer to engage in, by advertisement or otherwise, the business of plumbing, or plumbing contractor, as defined in this act, until such person, or a bona fide member of such partnership, or a bona fide officer of such firm, association, or corporation, as the case may be, shall have qualified and is licensed as a plumbing contractor as required by this act.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Minor repairs, consisting of repairing or replacing faucets or minor working parts of plumbing fixtures
